name: Dragon Attack Shield
shortDescription: A handmade dragon-themed attack shield developed from an original doodle into a paper model and eventually a finished painted shield.
description: The Dragon Attack Shield began as a doodle of an attack dragon shield. A few days later, I developed the idea into a paper design, modifying and folding it to create a physical example of the shield's intended shape.
A few years after making the paper version, I returned to the design and built the actual shield. The finished shield was painted black and features contrasting white and red eyes.
